topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I sat down at my desk, the chill of the room gripping me tighter as I stared at the screen. There it was, my words, my thoughts, displayed not just for the admissions board, but for anyone to see. My essay, meant to be a private bridge between my dreams and the college of my aspirations, was now a public piece. I couldn't help but wonder who else had read it, what they thought. I bit my lip, the silence in the room amplifying the echo of my heartbeat. The cursor on the screen blinked, a steady reminder of the exposure that now felt as vast and relentless as the ocean. I closed the tab, the room feeling a bit colder, a bit emptier, as I tried to grasp what this meant for me.
